title: Highlight of our Barcelona trip!
text: Although we had booked to go sailing on the Monday, the captain contacted us and suggested we go the day before as the weather conditions were better. So we changed plans and it was perfect. This is the attention to detail and regard for his clientele that sets this sailing trip apart from the rest. We had the whole boat to ourselves, were treated to wine and snacks and got to jump in the Med for a swim. Couldn’t ask for a better experience. I would recommend this sailing trip to anyone and doubt you’ll find a better one. Thank you for an amazing day and a beautiful memory that will last forev
author: marshat796

title: Perfect little boat ride....
text: Perfect little boat ride.  Teens loved jumping in.   Loved hearing the captains stories of sailing around the world.   Felt safe and well cared for.  Excellent host!
author: CathyHall

title: Hen party of 9
text: So glad I came across Sailing la vida, Aiser was an incredible hoast and opend up his home top us all. We booked for a Hen, and had lots of incredible snacks and drink included. The hummus was insane, he has amazing knowledge and shared a lot of the history with us throughout.  We all had an amazing time thank you so so much
author: Sasha_W

title: Awesome expirience
text: The experience with Asier was awesome! He provided cold drinks and snacks! And he was very attentive with us, highly recommend!
author: saramA838OU

title: Unbeatable experience to repeat!!!!!!
text: It was a pass, an unbeatable experience from the route to the captain who took us who became one more on our trip. Recommended 100%!!!
author: i_igop35

title: To repeat! Best way to do tourism in Barcelona
text: The boat is beautiful and perfect to enjoy from the sea of the incomparable Skyline of Barcelona. I loved the treatment of the captain, a true sailor who passionately conveys his love for the sea and always attentive to make us feel comfortable. Beer, wine, champagne, ... you can choose. And some very good snacks! I'll come back when it's warmer to take a bath:)
author: Mariqdelmar

title: A boat to gloat about
text: Asier, el Capitan was informative, sincere, and kind. There were only the four of us, and he still kept the appointment. He gave us tips for travelling in Costa Brava and told us to give him a call if we need help. It was absolutely beautiful experience and we got to swim in the Mediterranean.
author: Tinylia

title: Awesome Experience!
text: We were for a few days in Barcelona and we decided to do something different. Sailing with Asier was a great experience and I really recommend it. We will repeat for sure if we come back to Barcelona!
author: Ovon

title: Great expirenece! 100% recommended
text:
We were already having a good time in Barcelona, but this experience was the best part of our vacation. The captain was very nice and talkative, he also gave us a very good picnic. The views on the boat were amazing.

I can't just recommend this experience enough!!
author: Jorgeirureta

title: Excellent experience!
text: Some friends went on an excursion on this beautiful sailboat and it was an incredible experience! Asier is a great captain and made the experience much more enjoyable. Without a doubt an experience to remember. 100% recommendable!
